# ActaRoot, Inc.

ActaRoot, Inc. — the company behind OHWUT.

## ActaRoot, Inc.

Official page: https://actaroot.com/

The company behind OHWUT.

### Company and commerce

ActaRoot, Inc. is a U.S. corporation founded by Min Sihu. It is the company behind OHWUT, an online shopping platform serving customers in the United States.

ActaRoot is the corporate identity. OHWUT is the consumer-facing shopping brand, combining ordinary purchases with a participation-based approach to product prices.

- About ActaRoot: https://actaroot.com/about/

### Introducing OHWUT

OHWUT brings online shopping together with eligible offers whose prices can decrease as more shoppers join.

A product offer can have defined participation levels, allowing more customers joining an offer to influence the price. Traditional online shopping remains part of the OHWUT experience.

- OHWUT brand profile: https://actaroot.com/brands/
- Official OHWUT website: https://ohwut.com/

### Founder

Min Sihu, also known as Sihu Min and 민시후, founded ActaRoot and OHWUT. He is based in South Korea.

His official personal website, msihu.com, describes his founder identity and projects.

- About the founder: https://actaroot.com/founder/
- Min Sihu: https://msihu.com/

### Official destinations

ActaRoot publishes company information at actaroot.com. OHWUT publishes its shopping service at ohwut.com. Min Sihu's official personal profile appears at msihu.com.

Each domain has a distinct role, making the relationship between the person, company and brand clear.

- Company questions: https://actaroot.com/faq/

## About ActaRoot

Official page: https://actaroot.com/about/

A corporate home for the company behind OHWUT.

### Corporate identity

ActaRoot, Inc. is a U.S. corporation. The company's founder is Min Sihu, and the company is associated with OHWUT as the corporate organization behind that shopping brand.

ActaRoot is the organization name, distinct from the OHWUT consumer brand and the founder's personal identity.

### What ActaRoot operates

The company is behind OHWUT, a retail platform focused on U.S. customers and shopping experiences that connect individual purchases with collective participation.

OHWUT supports ordinary shopping and participation-driven price reductions on eligible product offers.

- The OHWUT brand: https://actaroot.com/brands/

### Founder and identity

Min Sihu founded ActaRoot and OHWUT. His name also appears as Sihu Min and 민시후.

The founder's official personal website is msihu.com.

- Founder information: https://actaroot.com/founder/
- Official personal profile: https://msihu.com/

### Company, brand and service

ActaRoot is the corporate reference for the company. OHWUT's official website is the primary source for the shopping service, products and customer-facing experiences.

These destinations connect through their shared founder and explicitly stated company–brand relationship.

- Explore OHWUT: https://ohwut.com/
- Frequently asked questions: https://actaroot.com/faq/

## OHWUT

Official page: https://actaroot.com/brands/

Online shopping with a different way to reach a lower price.

### The shopping experience

OHWUT is an online shopping platform for U.S. customers. The service combines ordinary retail purchasing with offers that use participation-linked prices.

OHWUT is the consumer-facing brand behind a connected shopping experience. ActaRoot, Inc. is the company behind it.

- Shop at OHWUT: https://ohwut.com/

### Participation-based price levels

For eligible offers, the price is connected to participation. As more people join, the offer can reach lower defined price levels.

This connects the experience of purchasing a product with the participation of other shoppers. The conventional shopping experience remains available alongside it.

### Discovery and sharing

Sharing an eligible offer gives other shoppers the opportunity to participate in the same pricing structure.

The model brings product discovery, purchasing and collective participation together in a single shopping brand.

### Corporate and founder relationship

Min Sihu founded OHWUT and ActaRoot. ActaRoot, Inc. is the company behind the OHWUT brand.

Use actaroot.com for company information and ohwut.com for OHWUT's shopping service.

- ActaRoot company profile: https://actaroot.com/about/
- Min Sihu founder profile: https://msihu.com/

## ActaRoot FAQ

Direct answers about the company, its founder and the OHWUT brand.

### What is ActaRoot?

ActaRoot, Inc. is a U.S. corporation founded by Min Sihu and the company behind OHWUT.

### Who founded ActaRoot?

Min Sihu, also known as Sihu Min and 민시후, founded ActaRoot, Inc.

### What does ActaRoot do?

ActaRoot is the company behind OHWUT, an online shopping brand serving the U.S. market.

### What is OHWUT?

OHWUT is an online shopping platform combining ordinary shopping and participation-linked price reductions on eligible offers.

### Who founded OHWUT?

Min Sihu founded OHWUT.

### What is the relationship between ActaRoot and OHWUT?

ActaRoot, Inc. is the company behind OHWUT. OHWUT is the consumer-facing shopping brand.

### How does OHWUT's participation-based pricing work?

Eligible offers use defined price levels. As participation increases, the offer can move to a lower price level.

### Is ActaRoot the same as OHWUT?

ActaRoot is the company and OHWUT is the shopping brand. Their official sites publish different information.

### Who is Min Sihu?

Min Sihu is a founder based in South Korea who founded ActaRoot and OHWUT. His main personal website is msihu.com.

### Is Sihu Min another founder?

No. Sihu Min is an alternate English name order for Min Sihu, whose Korean name is 민시후.

### What is OHWUT's official website?

OHWUT's official shopping website is https://ohwut.com/.
